source: Bangladesh Bank BRPD Circular No. 06, 8 March 2026 (Guidance for Banks in Implementing IFRS 9): section 4.5 (staging: significant increase in credit risk at 30 days past due, default at 90 days past due, forborne exposures and exposures whose SICR is not assessed in Stage 2), section 4.5.5 (cure: 90 days performing, 365 days for forborne exposures). The classified grades are those of BRPD Circular No. 15 of 27 November 2024. The bank's own choices (classified grades as Stage 3, the rating downgrade in notches) are in portable_data/policy/ifrs9_bank_policy.json.
